normalized_output:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).
NUMBER d = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[3]).
NUMBER[] values=[a,b,c,d].
NUMBER left=1.
NUMBER right=values.LENGTH.
LOOP (left<right) { NUMBER middle=(left+right)/2. IF (values[middle]<0) { left=middle+1. } ELSE { right=middle. } }
NUMBER left2=0.
NUMBER right2=values.LENGTH.
LOOP (left2<right2) { NUMBER middle=(left2+right2)/2. IF (values[middle]<=0) { left2=middle+1. } ELSE { right2=middle. } }
DISPLAYNL(left2).
